sources.note: ten papers on embeddings, retrieval and RAG; two-column PDFs with equations and tables. Only papers whose arXiv licence is CC BY 4.0 or CC0 were kept (licence read from arXiv's OAI metadata, 2026-11-19). The licence belongs to each paper, so it is recorded per paper.
sources.download_note: arXiv's certificate chain does not verify in Python on this machine, so the PDFs are fetched with curl (certificate checking stays on)
